audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns has no real numbers, and report[8].t misgenders Janna as "his" (Janna is she/her).
audit.why: Howling Gale charges up to 4.5s before firing on a 14s cooldown; her E shield is single-target so splitting pressure beats it. Gender per champ-data/champ-gender.js.
audit.corrected: breakdown.cooldowns rewritten with real numbers; report[8].t pronoun fixed.

audit.why: Level chart (Morgana favored levels 1 through first item, Janna favored 2+ items) matches her weak early trading and strong late peel/disengage kit.
Level 6 (Soul Shackles vs Monsoon) and 2-item scaling spikes are already correctly identified.

edits.before: World Atlas start. Mandate or Liandry's-lite lines, Sorcerer's, then Rylai's-Zhonya's paths. Add anti-heal early into his duo’s sustain.
edits.after: World Atlas start. Mandate or Liandry's-lite lines, Sorcerer's, then Rylai's-Zhonya's paths. Add anti-heal early — Monsoon (R) heals her whole side.

edits.before: - Janna Howling Gale: matchup-defining — The charged tornado breaks every engage — bait it before committing the dive. It writes your spacing rules. - E Black Shield is for saving fights, not seasoning trades. - The R opens or closes fights — pick one per cast.
edits.after: Howling Gale (Q) charges up to 4.5s before it flies, 14s cooldown — bait the charge before you commit the dive. Her E shield is single-target only, so split pressure across two threats. Bank your own E Black Shield for her Q, not for chip poke.

edits.before: W the pair, bank the Q visibly, shield the answer — the threat governs while the pool bills.
edits.after: Q the engage window: her Q knockup is 14s cooldown — after she uses it to escape, punish immediately.

edits.before: Q-poking into shields while their hook waits for yours to be down — the binding is the law; spend it like one.
edits.after: Her E shield only stops single-target burst — split damage across two targets and it can't cover both.

notes: missingInteractions flagged that Monsoon (R) heals Janna's side — folded that into report[8]'s anti-heal itemization line, which also fixed the misgendering lint hit there. Level chart already agrees between both layers and matches the packet's near-even 49.08% win rate, so left untouched.
